name: Workspace (IDE panes, layouts, docked + floating toolbars)
description: An IDE-style workspace for any app: panes in four areas (left, center, right, bottom) with tabs and splitters, floating pane windows, named workspace layouts, maximise, any pane shown / hidden / moved / floated at any time (tab drag, pane menu, context menu, app menu, toolbar). Toolbars: the app's defaults plus as many as a person adds, each docked on any edge or floating (drag the grip; drop near an edge to dock), items dragged to reorder or onto the trash, and a customizer listing every command in a categorized, sortable, searchable tree. On a phone every pane becomes a tab of one area. Kept per viewer on the device. Harvested Oct 22 2026 from Walkthrough Studio.

parts.label: Pane areas + tabs
parts.description: Left, center, right and bottom areas; panes are tabs; drag a tab to another area.

parts.label: Workspace layouts
parts.description: Named arrangements of the panes (the app defines them); each remembers its changes.

parts.label: Floating panes
parts.description: Any pane can float as a window on the window engine's physics: drag with snapping to the workspace edges and other panes, half / quarter zones, drop onto another pane to split it, resize from all 8 edges and corners (touch too), maximize / restore, minimize to a chip. No keep-on-screen.

parts.label: Maximise an area
parts.description: One area fills the workspace until you go back.

parts.label: Toolbars
parts.description: The app's default toolbars plus any number a person adds, docked top / bottom / left / right.

parts.label: Floating toolbars
parts.description: Drag a toolbar's grip to float it; drop it near an edge to dock it again.

parts.label: Toolbar customizer
parts.description: Every command, pane, layout, framework action, view, setting and look in a categorized, sortable, searchable tree; drag or tap + to add.

parts.label: Phone layout
parts.description: Below the breakpoint every visible pane is a tab of one area and side toolbars hide.

placeholders.note: Workspace layouts and user toolbars as asset@1 types (hot-swappable, shareable) — parked for the Fable rebuild.
Workspace state kept on axHub's data server for every device — not built.
